editorialSummary.heading: Check the hurricane reserves before booking school-break travel
highlights: Eight scheduled days off are also possible hurricane make-up dates
August 18 and Election Day on November 3 have no student classes
May 26 and 27 are early-release dates; final report cards follow June 8
paragraphs: The first interruption comes soon after school starts: August 18 is a professional learning day with no student classes. Later in the fall, Election Day on November 3 is another day off. These single weekdays matter for childcare planning, even though neither joins a full week of vacation. Veterans Day follows November 11, with progress reports scheduled the next day.

Eight dates are available for hurricane make-up. The list reaches into Thanksgiving week on November 23-24 and holiday break on December 21-22. January 4 and 5 are also reserves, even though both are currently student days off before the January 6 return. In March, the separate March 12 teacher workday comes just before spring break and is the last date in the make-up list. Keep those possibilities in mind when arranging a longer trip.

The two early-release dates come at the very end of the year, May 26 and 27. Families will need their school’s pickup times for those days. Final report cards are scheduled June 8, after classes have ended. Earlier report cards fall October 16, January 7 and March 24.

about.dataSource: The supplied PDF matches the current download linked on Flagler Schools’ Calendar page by SHA-256. Its visible heading is 2026-27 District Calendar. It supplies quarter lengths, an eight-date hurricane make-up list and a two-date early-release list. The month grids also identify progress reports and report cards through distinct symbols.
about.processing: Extracted the text and visually reviewed the full page and legend. Open circles mark progress reports on September 9, November 12, February 5 and April 22. Triangles mark report cards on October 16, January 7, March 24 and June 8; these shapes are not no-school or early-release markers. The May 27 square also establishes a quarter endpoint, alongside the printed semester-end/last-day wording and blue early-release mark, so one occurrence retains all four classifications. October 9, December 18 and March 11 remain ordinary quarter-end attendance dates. Eight purple half-circle dates retain their published no-school baseline and possible make-up flags, with the listed order in their notes. Thanksgiving and holiday breaks are divided into conditional single dates and fixed subranges so an entire break is not treated as conditional or guaranteed. The November 25-27 and December 23-January 1 fixed subranges have derived range boundaries within the larger official named breaks. The named Thanksgiving November 23-27 and holiday December 21-January 1 ranges remain official in the planning summaries. January 4 and 5 remain separate staff-day student closures; January 6 is the explicit baseline return. March 12 remains separate from March 15-19 spring break. There are 209 weekdays from August 10 to May 27, minus 22 fixed no-class weekdays and eight conditional reserve weekdays, yielding 179 planned attendance weekdays. This agrees with the sum of the printed quarter figures 43+42+45+49; neither sum nor grid count is a separately printed annual total. The longest-break statistic uses only fixed closures, while the planned winter stretch can be longer if reserves are unused. June 8 is final reporting, not attendance. August 3-7 pre-planning and post-year May 28 work/May 31 holiday dates are omitted. The PDF metadata title still says DRAFT 26-27 District Calendar, but the visible page has no draft label and the district currently links it as its district calendar. No approval date is inferred from that metadata or the December 2025 creation timestamp.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-2027 school year start and end in Flagler County?
faqs.answer: Students begin Monday, August 10, 2026 and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. The final two student days, May 26 and 27, have early release. The first day is not marked for a shortened schedule.

faqs.question: Why is there no school on August 18?
faqs.answer: Tuesday, August 18, 2026 is a professional learning day with no school for students. It falls during the second week of the school year. Students are scheduled to return Wednesday, August 19.

faqs.question: Is there school on Election Day?
faqs.answer: No. Tuesday, November 3, 2026 is listed as Election Day with no school. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, November 4. November 2 is not marked as an additional day off.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: The published Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026, with a scheduled return Monday, November 30. November 23 and 24 are possible hurricane make-up days. November 25-27 are outside that reserve list, so confirm any district changes before booking a full week away.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January?
faqs.answer: Holiday break is December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Students are also scheduled to be off January 4 and 5, with school resuming Wednesday, January 6. December 21-22 and January 4-5 may be used for hurricane make-up, so check for changes before making travel plans.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is March 12 also a day off?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027, with a scheduled return Monday, March 22. Friday, March 12 is a separate teacher workday with no school, but it is also the eighth listed hurricane make-up date. If that date remains free of classes, students have ten consecutive days off, March 12-21.

faqs.question: Which dates could be used for hurricane make-up?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists them in this order: October 12, November 23, November 24, December 21 and December 22, 2026, then January 4, January 5 and March 12, 2027. They are scheduled student days off until the district announces otherwise; listing them does not mean they have been activated.

faqs.question: Is October 12 a student holiday?
faqs.answer: Monday, October 12, 2026 is a teacher workday with no school for students on the published schedule. It is also the first listed hurricane make-up day, so the district could change student attendance on that date.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is a no-school holiday. Students are scheduled to return Thursday, November 12, which is also the first progress-report date of the second quarter.

faqs.question: Which other holidays give students a three-day weekend?
faqs.answer: Labor Day on September 7, 2026, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027 and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027 are Monday holidays with no school. Students are scheduled to return the following Tuesday after each one.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates?
faqs.answer: The two published early-release dates are Wednesday, May 26 and Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 27 is also the last day for students and the end of the second semester. December 18 is a quarter-end date without an early-release designation.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district calendar gives May 26 and 27 as early-release dates but does not publish dismissal times. Check your child’s school notice for the pickup and bus schedule before arranging after-school care.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: The quarter-end dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 11 and May 27, 2027. May 27 has early release. The other three quarter-end dates are not marked as shortened school days.

faqs.question: When are progress reports issued?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 9 and November 12, 2026, and February 5 and April 22, 2027. These are updates during the grading quarters, with separate report-card dates after each quarter ends.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks report cards for October 16, 2026, January 7, March 24 and June 8, 2027. June 8 is a final reporting date after the school year ends; students do not return to classes that day.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a day off on this calendar?
faqs.answer: Friday, March 26, 2027 is not marked as a student holiday or early-release day on Flagler’s district calendar. Families should plan for a regular school day unless a later school or district notice changes the schedule.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the school year?
faqs.answer: The four printed quarter totals are 43, 42, 45 and 49 student days, which add up to 179. A count of the published attendance dates agrees. The annual total is calculated from those figures; the PDF does not print a separate yearly total, and hurricane make-up could change the schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: Flagler Schools’ Calendar page links the one-page 2026-27 district PDF. For hurricane make-up decisions or later schedule changes, check district announcements and ParentSquare messages from your child’s school as well as the printable calendar.
